title: Learning spectral density functions in open quantum systems
summary: Spectral density functions quantify how environmental modes couple to quantum systems and govern their open dynamics. Inferring such frequency-dependent functions from time-domain measurements is an ill-conditioned inverse problem. Here, we use exactly solvable spin-boson models with pure-dephasing and amplitude-damping channels to reconstruct spectral density functions from noisy simulated data.
